underlying_goal: Install and integrate the Context Engineering repository (github.com/davidkimai/Context-Engineering) into their Claude Code setup, merging its CLAUDE.md with their existing one rather than replacing it
friction_detail: Windows path handling caused clone path issues, and slash command filenames were incorrectly named (research.agent.md instead of research.md), requiring user to prompt a check and Claude to fix.
brief_summary: User wanted to install the Context Engineering repo and merge its resources into their Claude Code setup; Claude accomplished this but needed a user prompt to catch and fix incorrectly named slash command files.
